CRIMINAL REVISION No. 2464 of 2024  JUVENILE CHILDREN IN CONFLICT WITH LAW
Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 Shri Umesh Prasad Pandey - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate for the State.

ORDER This is criminal revision under Section 102 of Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection of Children) Act,
2015 (for short "Act of 2015") filed on behalf of child in conflict with law through his legal guardian (father) Shri Lachhnu Panika against the order dated 07.05.2024 passed by the 4th Additional Sessions Judge, Baidhan District Singrauli in Criminal Appeal No.36/2019; whereby, appeal preferred by petitioner under Section 101 (2) of the Act of 2015 has been dismissed and order passed by Juvenile Justice Board dated 26.06.2019 convicting the petitioner under Section 376(2)(cha),
376(2) of IPC and 4/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 r/w 18 of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 to Section 18(1)(g)/(chha)

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: , has been affirmed.

By the order of the Juvenile Board dated 26.06.20219.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the petitioner for the aforesaid offence.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that false case has been NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1327 2 CRR-2464-2024 registered against him and he is in remand home and suffering confinement since approximate 14 months.
SIR report indicates that atmosphere of village and family of juvenile is pleasant.

He has no criminal record and if juvenile is given custody to his parents, there is no possibility of child suffering from any physical, mental or moral harm and there is also no possibility of his coming into contact of hardened criminals
. No other negative remark has been mentioned in the SIR prepared by the Probation Officer (District Child Protection Unit), District Singrauli.
Even otherwise medical report does not indicate commission of offence in specific term.
Story indicates an improbable event.
Looking to the tender age of the petitioner (juvenile), a chance be given to reform himself and to make course correction to mend his ways and to become a better citizen.

According to report of Probation Officer, his conduct in the remand home is satisfactory and he undertakes to perform community service in view of Section 18(1) (c) of the Act of 2015 as well as in the light of the judgment of this Court in the case of Sunita Gandharva Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2020 (3) MPLJ(Cri.) 247.

entities.text: Sunita Gandharva Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2020 (3) MPLJ(Cri.) 247
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Confinement may dampen his spirit and would take away a chance of petitioner to reform himself.

He undertakes to cooperate in trial and would involve himself in creative pursuits and sports and educational activities and would not involve in any criminal activities in future and would not be source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant party in any manner.
His company would be good and people of law abiding traits.
Thus, prayed for grant of bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of this revision petition in the form of bail application.

4. It is further submitted that mother of victim has filed an affidavit stating NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1327 3 CRR-2464-2024 that she has no objection if the conflict boy has been released on bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Looking to the fact situation of the case, period of custody and SIR, without commenting on the merits of the case, petition is allowed and it is directed that on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount by father/natural guardian of the petitioner, custody of petitioner be handed over to him with the clear stipulation to produce him before the Investigating Officer/trial Court as and when required.

It is further directed that parents of petitioner shall take responsibility of his conduct and would submit report of conduct of petitioner every month to the Probation Officer, Office of District Child Protection Officer,
District Singrauli and petitioner shall not move in the vicinity of complainant and would not intimidate or threat them in any manner, else the benefit of bail granted by this Court shall be withdrawn immediately.
